register.labelZh: WALL 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: wall off 可以清楚表示把危險區域或私人區域與其他人分隔開來。；wall up 可以表示舊門口、窗戶、壁爐或其他開口已被完全封起。；人們談論維修、舊建築物、停用房間和安全工程時,經常會使用這些表達。；你可以清楚說明某個區域只是被隔開,還是某個開口已用磚完全封起。
register.summaryEn: Wall off can clearly describe separating a dangerous or private area from other people. Wall up helps you explain that an old door, window, fireplace or other opening has been completely closed. These expressions often appear when people talk about repairs, old buildings, unused rooms and safety work. You can show whether an area was separated or whether an opening was completely filled with bricks.
contextsZh: 準確表達兩種不同的封閉方式
contextsEn: Express two different kinds of closing clearly
